articles.summary: FORT WORTH, Texas , Aug. 14, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- FirstCash Holdings, Inc. (“FirstCash” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: FCFS), the leading international operator of pawn stores, today announced that it has completed its previously announced acquisition of H&T Group plc (“H&T”).
articles.title: FirstCash Completes Acquisition of H&T Group; Combination Establishes FirstCash as U.K.’s Leading Pawnbroker; Now Operates over 3,300 Retail Pawn Locations in the U.S., Latin America and the U.K.
